verses.en: Israel is an empty vine, he bringeth forth fruit unto himself: according to the multitude of his fruit he hath increased the altars; according to the goodness of his land they have made goodly images.
verses.sm: Isaraelu O Isaraelu, o le vine ia e mafala; ua ia fua mai ni fua e fai mona; faapei ona tele o lona fua, ua faapea ona faateleina e la O fata faitaulaga; faapei ona lelei o lona laueleele, ua faapea ona latou gaosi lelei o tupua.

verses.en: Their heart is divided; now shall they be found faulty: he shall break down their altars, he shall spoil their images.
verses.sm: Ua faalotoloto lua i latou; ua nofo sala nei i latou; na te lepetia a latou fata faitaulaga, na te faaumatia a latou tupua.

verses.en: For now they shall say, We have no king, because we feared not the LORD; what then should a king do to us?
verses.sm: Auà e faapea mai nei i latou, Ua leai se tupu ia te i matou, aua ua matou le matatau i le ALII; se a foi se mea e faia e le tupu ia i matou?

verses.en: They have spoken words, swearing falsely in making a covenant: thus judgment springeth up as hemlock in the furrows of the field.
verses.sm: Ua latou fai mai upu, ua tauto pepelo, ua osi le feagaiga; e tupu ae foi le faamasinoga, e pei o laau cona i utu O fanua.

verses.en: The inhabitants of Samaria shall fear because of the calves of Beth-aven: for the people thereof shall mourn over it, and the priests thereof that rejoiced on it, for the glory thereof, because it is departed from it.
verses.sm: E fefefe e ua nonofo i Samaria ona o tamai povi o Petavene; aua e fetagisi ai ona tagata, o ona ositaulaga foi e na fiafia i ai; aua o lona mamalu ua te“a ma ia.

verses.en: It shall be also carried unto Assyria for a present to king Jareb: Ephraim shall receive shame, and Israel shall be ashamed of his own counsel.
verses.sm: E avea foi lenei mea i Asuria e fai ma mea alofa i le tupu o Iarepa; e ma Efaraima, e masiasi foi Isaraelu ona O lana lava pule.

verses.en: As for Samaria, her king is cut off as the foam upon the water.
verses.sm: O Samaria ua fano lona tupu, e pei o si fasi laau i le fogavai.

verses.en: The high places also of Aven, the sin of Israel, shall be destroyed: the thorn and the thistle shall come up on their altars; and they shall say to the mountains, Cover us; and to the hills, Fall on us.
verses.sm: E faaumatia foi mea maualuga i Avene, o le agasala a Isaraelu; e tutupu ae le laau tuitui ma le laau talatala i o latou fata faitaulaga; latou te fai atu foi i mauga, Inà tanu mai ia ia te i matou. E faapea foi i mea maupuepue, Ina mafuli mai ia i luga ia te i matou.

verses.en: O Israel, thou hast sinned from the days of Gibeah: there they stood: the battle in Gibeah against the children of iniquity did not overtake them.
verses.sm: Isaraelu e, talu mai ona po o Kipea ua e agasala ai; ua latou tutumau ai; na le oo atu ia te i latou i Kipea le taua i tagata agaleaga.

verses.en: It is in my desire that I should chastise them; and the people shall be gathered against them, when they shall bind themselves in their two furrows.
verses.sm: O loʻu loto, ou te aoai ia te i latou; e faapotopotoina foi tagata e tau ma i latou, pe a ou fusifusi ia te i latou ona o a latou agasala e lua.

verses.en: And Ephraim is as an heifer that is taught, and loveth to tread out the corn; but I passed over upon her fair neck: I will make Ephraim to ride; Judah shall plow, and Jacob shall break his clods.
verses.sm: O Efaraima foi o le povi fafine ia ua aʻoaʻoina, ua fia soli saito lava; a ua ou alu atu lava au i lona ua lalelei; ou te faatietie se tasi ia Efaraima, e suatia le eleele e Iuta e faamáluluina e Iakopo lona laueleele.

verses.en: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap in mercy; break up your fallow ground: for it is time to seek the LORD, till he come and rain righteousness upon you.
verses.sm: Ia outou lulu saito mo outou ma le amiotonu, ia outou selesele mai ma le amio lelei; ia outou suatia lo outou fanua vaoa; aua ua 00 i ona po e saili atu ai i le ALII, seia auo mai o ia, ma faatotò ifo le amiotonu i luga ia te outou.

verses.en: Ye have plowed wickedness, ye have reaped iniquity; ye have eaten the fruit of lies: because thou didst trust in thy way, in the multitude of thy mighty men.
verses.sm: Ua outou suatia le agasala, ua outou selesele mai le leaga; ua outou aai le fua o le pepelo; aua na e faatuatua i lou ala, ma le toatele o ou tagata totoa.

verses.en: Therefore shall a tumult arise among thy people, and all thy fortresses shall be spoiled, as Shalman spoiled Beth-arbel in the day of battle: the mother was dashed in pieces upon her children.
verses.sm: O lea e tupu ai le vavaò i ou tagata, e faaumatia ou “olo uma lava, e pei ona faaumatia e Salemana o Petarepelu i le aso na tau ai le taua; na palasi le tiná faatasi ma ana tama.

verses.en: So shall Beth-el do unto you because of your great wickedness: in a morning shall the king of Israel utterly be cut off.
verses.sm: E faapea lava ona faia ia te outou i Peteli ona o la outou amio e matuā leaga; e matuā fano lava le tupu o Isaraelu i le taeao.
